comparisons.peer_topic: Data Center AI Inference Platforms and Cloud Services
comparisons.peer_summary: The company launched AI inference platforms combining software with Ada, Hopper, and Grace Hopper processors for generative AI and LLMs. It also introduced NVIDIA DGX Cloud and AI Foundations to help businesses create and operate custom large language models.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA disclose specific strategic initiatives to expand their AI software ecosystems and hardware-integrated solutions for generative AI workloads. AMD describes consolidating teams and acquiring Silo AI to build a comprehensive software ecosystem and optimize ROCm for training LLMs on its accelerators. Similarly, NVIDIA launched AI inference platforms combining full-stack software with its processors (Ada, Hopper, Grace Hopper) and introduced DGX Cloud services to help businesses operate custom LLMs. Both companies are actively investing in software stacks and integrated platforms to accelerate the deployment of large language models and generative AI workloads on their respective hardware architectures.

sentences.text: To execute our AI strategy, we brought together multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio.

Silo AI has also developed a software stack used to train multiple state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) on AMD Instinct accelerators that can accelerate the development of highly-performant AMD training solutions.

In Data Center, we launched AI inference platforms that combine our full-stack inference software with NVIDIA Ada, NVIDIA Hopper and NVIDIA Grace Hopper processors optimized for generative AI, LLMs and other AI workloads.
We introduced NVIDIA DGX Cloud and AI Foundations to help businesses create and operate custom large language models and generative AI models.
